Quick checklist before opening:
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`python scripts/run_tests_minimal.py`)
- [ ] If you added a new module, you also added at least one test for it
- [ ] If you changed a public function's signature, you updated callers and docs
- [ ] No em-dashes in docstrings or markdown (the lint workflow checks this)
-->

**What this changes**

A one-paragraph description of the change.

**Why**

What problem this solves, or which issue it addresses.

**How to verify**

Either a command the reviewer can run, or a description of what the existing tests cover for this change.

**Things to flag for the reviewer**

Trade-offs, future-work items spawned by this PR, or anything that would benefit from a second pair of eyes.
